chunks: Abu Jamīlah narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
That he asked him about the garment of a Magian: "May I wear it and perform salat (prayer) in it?" He said: "Yes."
He said: I said, "They drink wine." He said: "Yes, we buy the Sābiriyyah garments, then we wear them and do not wash them."

key_terms.السَّابِرِيَّةَ: Sābiriyyah garments, a known type of fabric or clothing
key_terms.الْمَجُوسِيِّ: a Magian, referring to a Zoroastrian
key_terms.ثَوْبِ: garment or clothing item under discussion for prayer

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to wear the garment of a Magian and pray in it without washing it?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates the permissibility of wearing a garment belonging to a Magian and performing salat (prayer) in it. The Imam عليه السلام supports this by stating that garments obtained from such people were worn without washing, despite their drinking wine.
